modes.early: Python structural preflight,batch4,early summary and labels

methodology.timing_scope: Backend ingestion handler through background enrichment; excludes browser transfer/render/poll and subsequent chart planning
methodology.memory_scope: Child resource.getrusage high-water process RSS through enrichment,captured before verification; not DuckDB query-budget usage
methodology.verification: Outside timed/memory window,one thread and1GB budget. Source SHA,row counts,physical metadata and exact ordered typed row SHA for disk; pandas value hash and dtypes for wine.
methodology.early_context: First3 raw rows x20columns for summary;12 evenly spaced raw rows for labels;cells capped160characters. Labels omit unvalidated full-column statistics. Roles still wait for full-column validation.
methodology.excluded: Initial combined arm excluded because the unguarded native parser did not preserve strict-quote rejection semantics.

decisions.early_ai: promoted: enabled by default; bounded requests and stale-version guards; rollback with ANALYTICO_EARLY_AI=0
decisions.native_validation: not promoted: quoted taxi/retail retain canonical Python validation,so initial gains were ineligible. Experimental quote-free path remains default0.
decisions.larger_batches: rejected:no consistent latency gain; increased process RSS

limitations: Three randomized runs per arm on one development machine; not p95 or universal latency guarantees.
AI roles:117/120 correct per arm,0wrong applied,3unknown;40unique columns repeated3times per arm.
Taxi and retail label variants were manually reviewed; no independently adjudicated label-accuracy gold set.
Verification budgets are separate from64MB ingestion cap; process RSS includes libraries and can exceed that cap.
Stopped runs with verification-harness errors or expired /tmp fixtures are excluded. Restored fixtures matched all frozen source SHA values.
